acceptanceCriteria.text: Raid, Monster, Gathering, Brigand and Tower restore their last chosen team on reopen and after popup reload.
Selections are isolated by account and dialog, survive unrelated option saves, and stale asynchronous reads cannot overwrite newer user choices.
Clicking backdrop does not close any dialog; explicit close buttons and Escape still work.
Meaningful regression tests, typecheck and production build pass; changelog updated.

checkpointPayload.description: User requests restoring the last chosen team in every dialog that supports team selection. Also disable dismissal from backdrop clicks in all dialogs, retaining explicit close controls and Escape.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Add account/dialog-specific remembered selections with guarded async loading. 2. Integrate Raid, Solo Monster, Gathering, Brigand and Tower; preserve selection when preferences or roster refresh. 3. Remove backdrop close handlers from shared and standalone dialogs. 4. Verify persistence/reopen/account races and close behavior, typecheck/build and update release changelog.
checkpointPayload.title: Remember dialog teams and disable backdrop dismissal

Removed backdrop close handlers from shared ModalDialog and 10 standalone overlays; retained close buttons and Escape. Added actual composable/squad recreation and race tests and compiled Vue modal interaction test. Verification: 633 tests total, 621 pass, 12 optional private-data skips, 0 failures; typecheck and production build passed.
